notes: Move Zen Visualizer to where it belongs: ViperTab Zen edition. Removed the fullscreen takeover button from Main's Sound widget (it was misplaced there last release). Added a Zen-edition-only equalizer button to the menu bar that opens the visualizer in a full-screen overlay — controls auto-fade on idle, Esc exits. Main's Sound widget is back to plain type/palette/play controls; the fullscreen mode is now exclusive to Zen.
